create_jsondfreducer_benchmark: create a JsonDFReducer to join JSON result files and compute MAE metrics for a benchmark
run_reduce_benchmark: run the reduce method on a BenchmarkReducer to join results, compute metrics, and log them
compute_metrics_forces: compute metrics including MAE, cosine similarity, and magnitude error for forces predictions using JsonDFReducer
join_results_json: join results from multiple JSON files into a single pandas DataFrame using JsonDFReducer
load_targets_dataframe: load target data from a JSON file into a sorted pandas DataFrame using JsonDFReducer.load_targets
